releases.name: Lane Listener 2026-11-20
releases.body: Created Lane Listener, a drive-thru order listener. You type or speak an order to the lane and it reads the order back as a ticket. Added tap mode for picking quantity, size, and options by hand, and a Teach tab for showing it phrases it did not understand.

jobs.description: A drive-thru order listener that turns typed or spoken orders into a ticket.

releases.name: Packet Baron 2026-11-20
releases.body: Added world news events that can block play, with a popup and a decoy button. Added glitter special editions, sweeteners, blended drinks, egg packets, and many new packet kinds. Packets are now drawn as crimped packets with illustrations, and the Tower view shows each packet line as a floor. Added made versus sold graphs, profit rates for each packet with sort buttons, and endless play with big number formats. Added the 50/50 Machine, which rolls random half and half combo packets.

jobs.description: A tapping and idle game about building a condiment packet empire.

releases.name: Stackloom 2026-11-20
releases.body: Added cashing out and high scores. The Office tab now has Retire, which scores your cash plus a year of royalties, and Sell the studio, which scores what a buyer pays for the building, rooms, staff, and backlist, scaled by reputation. Both take a second tap to confirm and end the run. The end screen, also shown when the studio folds, takes a three letter tag and an optional link and submits the score to the shared Score Hub board as full-meta-packet, shows the top of the board, and keeps your best runs on the phone. A button on the Office tab shows the board any time.

jobs.description: A studio game with orders, terminals, agents, developers, and offices.

releases.name: Hush 2026-11-20 (2)
releases.body: Tapping the Clock fixer badge while the fixer is off now opens the Hush app info page first, where Samsung's restricted setting gets unlocked, and the next tap opens the accessibility screen to switch the fixer on.

jobs.description: An Android app that blocks notifications and releases them in a digest.
